$comment: Everything the dashboard knows about your accounts, cards, and categories.
Category edits need only an API restart. Account edits also need
Accounts are matched on name. A new entry is created with its openingBalance
and no transactions; an entry that already exists is left alone, so editing
openingBalance afterwards does nothing and renaming creates a second account.
Nothing is ever deleted here, because transactions reference these rows.
kind is 'bank' or 'credit_card'. For a card, charges push the balance
negative and the dashboard shows the amount owed.
role is optional and wires up the fixed buttons: 'salary' is where Add
Salary credits to, 'primary' is where Transfer sends money. Use each once.
